logic.par.text:
to artifact_priority_score with stable_units as number, fragile_units as number, packing_stations as number, expedited as yesno giving number:
    let artifact_total be stable_units plus fragile_units
    let packing_units be stable_units times 6 plus fragile_units times 11
    if expedited:
        set packing_units to packing_units plus packing_stations times 4
    let capacity_units be packing_stations times 40
    let overflow_units be packing_units minus capacity_units
    if overflow_units is less than 0:
        set overflow_units to 0
    let inspection_rounds be number from (artifact_total divided by 5)
    give back packing_units plus overflow_units times 5 plus inspection_rounds times 7

main.par.text:
include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text
a request_input has accession_key as text, stable_units as number, fragile_units as number, packing_stations as number, expedited as yesno
a response_body has accession_key as text, artifact_total as number, packing_units as number, capacity_units as number, overflow_units as number, inspection_rounds as number, priority_score as number, accession_state as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Artifact Accession", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with accession_key key, artifact_total 0, packing_units 0, capacity_units 0, overflow_units 0, inspection_rounds 0, priority_score 0, accession_state state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    let credential be (maybe item "authorization" of request's headers) otherwise ""
    if credential is not "Bearer accession-045":
        set item "www-authenticate" of headers to "Bearer realm=artifact-accession"
        give back a controlled_response with status 401, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's accession_key, "authorization_required")
    if body's stable_units is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's accession_key, "invalid")
    if body's fragile_units is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's accession_key, "invalid")
    if body's packing_stations is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's accession_key, "invalid")
    if body's packing_stations is 0:
        if body's stable_units plus body's fragile_units is more than 0:
            set item "x-validation" of headers to "packing_stations"
            give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's accession_key, "invalid")
    let total be body's stable_units plus body's fragile_units
    let packing be body's stable_units times 6 plus body's fragile_units times 11
    if body's expedited:
        set packing to packing plus body's packing_stations times 4
    let capacity be body's packing_stations times 40
    let overflow be packing minus capacity
    if overflow is less than 0:
        set overflow to 0
    let rounds be number from (total divided by 5)
    let state be "accepted"
    if overflow is more than 0:
        set state to "queued"
    let result be a response_body with accession_key body's accession_key, artifact_total total, packing_units packing, capacity_units capacity, overflow_units overflow, inspection_rounds rounds, priority_score (artifact_priority_score with body's stable_units, body's fragile_units, body's packing_stations, body's expedited), accession_state state
    set item "location" of headers to "/api/v9/artifact-accessions/" plus body's accession_key
    set item "x-accession-state" of headers to state
    give back a controlled_response with status 201, headers headers, body result
